messages.subject: error in 'bootLRTS'
parts:
Hello,

I’m using tidyLPA for the first time on a fairly small dataset (~3600x4), but have been unsuccessful in getting it to run.  Two of the variables in the model are binary; the other two are continuos with values ranging from 0-10.

I used the following code:

datin %>%

+     select(v1,v2,v3,v4) %>%

+     estimate_profiles(2:3)

 

But get this error:

Error in bootLRTS[, 1:g, drop = FALSE] : subscript out of bounds

 

I am able to successfully use tidyLPA on a test dataset (subset of pisaUSA15).

 

Does anyone have any clues about what is causing this error?  Is it something in the structure of the data?

Thanks for your help.

 

M. Pettinger
